fact: On 26 January 2025 the Ministry of Interior said the Civil Status Authority, under the supervision of the Attorney General's office, was continuing the Intilaqa project to match the electronic data in the civil status system against its paper originals in the civil registers, with work that includes developing the technical systems and training staff; it gives no office count, plan document or source of finance.
title: تواصل مشروع الانطلاقة لمطابقة البيانات الالكترونية بمنظومة الأحوال المدنية
